description: This file defines the AOD_LogicHooks class which contains deprecated hook methods for handling module save, delete, and restore events in SuiteCRM, specifically for the AOD_Index module. The methods perform indexing operations when relevant events occur, with checks to prevent execution during certain system states.

classes.name: AOD_LogicHooks
classes.description: A class providing deprecated logic hook methods for the AOD_Index module to handle indexing on save, delete, and restore actions.

methods.name: saveModuleChanges
methods.description: Handles indexing when a module record is saved, unless it belongs to the AOD_Index module or during installation.

methods.name: saveModuleDelete
methods.description: Handles removing the index when a module record is deleted, unless it belongs to the AOD_Index module or during installation.

methods.name: saveModuleRestore
methods.description: Handles re-indexing when a module record is restored, unless it belongs to the AOD_Index module or during installation.

search-terms: deprecated PHP class for module events
